LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.6 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Articulation • Intonation (tone and moo
Topic 2.8: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of Reading 2.6 Guided Reading (2 lessons) • Articulation • Intonation (tone and moo in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you read confidently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out words and phrases related to weather patterns from word charts (e.g. 晴天 qíngtiān、雨天 yǔtiān、风天 fēngtiān、阴天 yīntiān ) ,

2. chant out phrases and sentences related to weather pattern from the given text (e.g. 今天是阴天。),

3. work collaboratively to read aloud the text about the description of different weather patterns for feedback from peers,

4. take turns to match pictures and corresponding weather patterns by rotating a weather display wheel then read them out,

5. read and answer questions on weather patterns collaboratively (e.g. 明天天 气怎么样 ? 明天是多云。),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out words and phrases related to weather patterns from word charts (e.g. 晴天 qíngtiān、雨天 yǔtiān、风天 fēngtiān、阴天 yīntiān ) ,
2. chant out phrases and sentences related to weather pattern from the given text (e.g. 今天是阴天。),
3. work collaboratively to read aloud the text about the description of different weather patterns for feedback from peers,
4. take turns to match pictures and corresponding weather patterns by rotating a weather display wheel then read them out,
5. read and answer questions on weather patterns collaboratively (e.g. 明天天 气怎么样 ? 明天是多云。),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: The learner uses digital technology to effectively record weather patterns in their neighbourhood.

Values:
Peace: The learner avoids hurting others by giving honest and constructive feedback to their peers when they read aloud texts on

descriptions of weather patterns.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness: This is promoted as the learner makes observations of the weather patterns in their neighbourhood for

the given period.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Social Studies in the concept of weather patterns in their environment.
